tasks.label: build + refresh Openness AllowList
args: dotnet build 'TiaOpennessApp.csproj' -c Debug --nologo -v q; & '.\bin\Debug\net48\TiaOpennessApp.exe' --check-allowlist *> $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Start-Process -FilePath '.\bin\Debug\net48\TiaOpennessApp.exe' -ArgumentList '--fix-allowlist' -Verb RunAs -Wait }
